## Result

- Skill: design-review
- Review status: approved
- Package members: Design, Test and System at the exact subjects below; two scoped published-skill-first legacy amendments. The package covers retention, protective-value criteria, source/consumer disposition and their relevant interactions.
- Upstream review ID: proposal-review-r2.
- Review ID and round: design-review-r1, round 1.
- Material findings: none.
- Correction targets: none.
- Recording status: recorded through the primary review-record operation.
- Open blockers: none.
- Immediate next stage: route; authorized Delivery planning may rely on this exact package. This review performs no routing change.
- Claim limitations: Design package approval only. No source removal, test retirement, implementation correctness, final Verify, branch/PR readiness, publication or installation approval is claimed.

## Exact package and independence

- `docs/design/design/design.md` — `sha256:00658fdd2478af5566e3ec41fcadaa7c38ecb9a2e53294db42edd64959736602`.
- `docs/design/test/test.md` — `sha256:2712953eb34943a51c0b7212d56d0ed99bf0050cae393aca040b453396e03d76`.
- `docs/design/system/system.md` — `sha256:1a9879ee9686761ef43660ede89784cd48b4ce0b9381bde4fc294e7f1c3655be`.
- `specs/published-skill-first-repository-simplification.md` — `sha256:30b13b194dda48f9b6b164a7f8ac9d534893db1183de71f53f8c8ee226c48bb6`.
- `specs/published-skill-first-repository-simplification.test.md` — `sha256:88d419ef1b428654e723cde14cde8f06026f2fe2a3e5d27b85d148d2bbaf305c`.

Parent necessary-design-author authored these five contributions. This separately delegated reviewer authored none of the contributions and made no engineering edits. I inspected every package member, the complete approved merged proposal and its independent r2 judgment, relevant source/disposition boundaries and governing assessment criteria. My judgment is independent of the author's checks. Recording mode is formal-lifecycle; no automated downstream execution is selected by this review.

## Assessment

| Criterion | Judgment | Basis |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Required behavior and technical realization | pass | DES-SR-21 defines usable current meaning and current-use retention; TEST-SR-14 supplies a concrete scoped check contract; System identifies exact source sections, operational remainders and consumers. Existing files and owning models can realize these changes without a new service or model. |
| Constraints and boundaries | pass | No new Validation model, broad validation redesign, runtime test removal, release authority or Skill expansion is selected. Published-skill-first R1–13/15/16/21/23–29 and separately amended stored-format behavior retain their owners. Runtime persistence safeguards and independent assessments remain intact. |
| Approved goals and feasibility | pass | The package selects actual later removal of one ADR, one diagram and three redundant architecture subsections, not merely an inventory or rename. Existing models receive necessary meaning; mixed operational sources remain with reasons. The absence of a relevant archive duplicate is an inspected limit, not a requirement to purge unrelated archives. No savings measurement is invented. |
| Ownership, trust and recovery | pass | Design owns document disposition; Test owns selected protection criteria; System composes them. Review and Closeout retains evidence applicability and closeout, CLI/Record Format current persistence. Newly discovered operational readers stop affected removal; recovery restores the affected source/consumer slice without rewriting judgments. |
| Decisions and historical identity | pass | The validation ADR's deterministic/semantic/runtime distinction, supported-target proof, composed release boundary, narrow materialization, bounded retirement and meaningful alternatives remain at retained operational requirements and SYS-DEC-04. The source-qualified map preserves its historical identity without treating an old approval as new-model approval. Earlier Skill/method archive commitments remain scoped; historical records and releases are excluded from deletion. |
| Shared contracts and consumers | pass | Test's retained-contract table states actual requirements, populations and scoped R14/R17–20/R22 changes. The two legacy notices refer to that owner and preserve their unselected original rules, proof IDs and input identities. System allocates exact navigation, ledger fixture, selectors, skills and candidate metadata dispositions; discovered impact returns to Design when necessary. |
| Assessment and acceptance basis | pass | Model-local and composed outcomes distinguish complete transfer, mixed retention, incidental historical citation, operational-reader discovery and dependent package identity. Delivery can derive focused proof from these outcomes. New assessment alone does not require reruns; unchanged proof needs affirmative RC-SR-15 applicability, while fresh final whole-change Code Review and distinct Verify remain mandatory. |
| Migration precision and remaining scope | pass | Whole-source ADR/diagram dispositions and three exact architecture subsection boundaries are named; surrounding Validation and Generation Scripts, Validation flow and Validation layering remain. FU-012 must receive the selected direction and residual ownership, while FU-013–18 stay separate. Adoption is coordinated, not triggered by this approval. |

## Source preservation and applicability

The retained Test table is an actionable replacement for the selected population rather than a generic preserve-behavior reference. R14's failure, deterministic rationale, simpler owner, invocation, repair and retirement meaning survives. R17/R18 require accepted/rejected-case analysis and investigation of unknown protection; R19 distinguishes replacement detection from explicit obligation retirement and permits applicable old proof under RC-SR-15; R20 retains all surviving contractual failures; R22 requires truthful removal/owner reporting without a compulsory savings benchmark. Unchanged suites are not retroactively required to receive annotations or new ledger entries for this cleanup.

The ADR and selected architecture descriptions were inspected against their proposed destinations. Their remaining operational guarantees are already stated in retained published-skill-first requirements; deleting these descriptions does not delete the operational specification or its meaningful test intent. Current record validity uses the already adopted v2 owner, not the old diagram's YAML/Markdown label. No old standalone parser, target-runtime benchmark or historical installation gate is reinstated. The mixed spec/proof documents remain necessary for unmigrated responsibilities, so their retention is consistent with the proposal's current-use rule.

Both legacy amendments are new-profile-only: they introduce exact applicability notices for this consolidation and do not revise the historical boundary/proof rows or claim their old reviews assessed the new contract. I inspected their complete member text and the compact boundary/feature method. Original BND/INT/PRF/E/T identifiers remain interpretable under the original population and explicit selected exception. Their old Next artifacts/Readiness and model drafting-basis sections are preserved earlier planning history, not current routing authority. The selected change registry and exact new review define the current package.

The prior Skill Verify report records successful common adoption and a fresh final Code Review basis. It supports the limited System owner-reference correction; this review does not renew that previous Verify, repeat its pilot or certify other skills. FU-012 still contains earlier prospective direction and is explicitly a necessary later consumer correction. That current planning allocation does not justify leaving it stale at adoption.

No necessary current historical assessment depends on treating the removed ADR or diagram as replacement approval. Exact new review basis and current content supply the new claim. Incidental historical citations can remain historical without source stubs; an actual relied-on original or operational reader discovered later must instead receive its stated retention/reconciliation treatment before removal.

## Evidence and limitations

Inspected: complete five-file package and embedded examples; merged proposal and r2; current change registry, scoped model/review/evidence/finding/blocker/applicability context; Constitution's governing retention, review and documentation rules; the complete validation ADR/diagram; exact selected and adjacent architecture sections; RC-SR-01–18 and relevant Workflow retirement mappings; FU-012–18; prior Skill Verify's adoption explanation; and the ledger regression's retained fixture reference. These are package or triggered dependencies. No project-map inference or whole-repository dependency-completeness claim is made.

The author's necessary-design-authoring evidence reports passing five-member model/boundary structure, model prose and readability checks, with explicit unchanged legacy prose-header errors. I ran `python /tmp/check-design-amendments.py` and `git diff --check`: both passed. The comparison independently confirmed all original legacy bytes remain outside the insertion, new amendment prose/links pass, and full-source legacy errors exactly match the baseline; those whole-file prose failures are not relabeled passes. Required behavior, ownership and preservation are assessed semantically here rather than inferred from these checks. Runtime/package/release execution is not necessary for this Design-only judgment and is not claimed.

Recording uses fresh `rigorloop context`, exact `rigorloop subject inspect --content full --max-bytes 1000000`, and targeted `rigorloop review record design-review-r1`. The exact five package subjects are included even though only three are model registry entries. Unchanged source and authority subjects are conflict-checked reads. Original proposal reviews, engineering files and routing state are preserved. No findings existed in the selected current context and this first pass identifies no required correction. Approval follows RC-SR-03's adequately assessed/no-required-correction case, with applicability limited to these subjects and the selected consolidation.
independence_basis: Parent authored the five engineering contributions; separately delegated reviewer authored none, inspected complete members and relevant source/authority basis, and made no engineering edits. This is independent first-pass judgment, not author self-assessment.
